name: @test-staged/monorepo
description: Test your staged files - Monorepo Root

scripts.release:minor: pnpm -r exec npm version minor && commit-and-tag-version --release-as minor && git add . && git commit --amend --no-edit && git tag -f v$(node -pe "require('./package.json').version") HEAD
scripts.release:major: pnpm -r exec npm version major && commit-and-tag-version --release-as major && git add . && git commit --amend --no-edit && git tag -f v$(node -pe "require('./package.json').version") HEAD
scripts.release:patch: pnpm -r exec npm version patch && commit-and-tag-version --release-as patch && git add . && git commit --amend --no-edit && git tag -f v$(node -pe "require('./package.json').version") HEAD
